extraction_notes: Digitised main-text performance Figures 1 and 2. In Figure 1 only the filled Ba–Co/C series was included; the open KM1 series is published comparison data rather than measurements of this paper. Figure 3 was skipped because it is an Arrhenius plot; Figure 4 was skipped because it is XRPD characterisation. The overlapping zero-conversion endpoints in Figure 2 at H2/(H2+N2)=0 and 1 were not assigned as separate catalyst/temperature points.
